title: files.upload request
description: plugin → companion, the payload of a `call` with op `files.upload`. Upload one workspace file for the request the plugin is answering: attached to the agent's reply, or saved into the organization's Files at `to`. The companion reads only inside its workspace, refuses a request it did not ring (`not_permitted`) and sends the grant ask at most once.

localPath.description: Relative to the workspace, or absolute and inside it.

to.description: A path in the organization's Files to save the file at, instead of attaching it to the reply.

overwrite.description: Replace a file already at `to`. A change to existing work: it asks a person first.
